    ## 2026-03-08 — Jess / Flatmates / MC debugging
    
    - Post-reboot triage: NordVPN daemon installed/running but logged out; Tailscale actually up despite one misleading OpenClaw status readout.
    - Jess failure after reboot was initially caused by proxy dependency timing: Jess used `socks5h://127.0.0.1:1080`, and startup happened before the SOCKS tunnel was ready.
    - Confirmed `socks-tunnel.service` provides the local SOCKS proxy on `127.0.0.1:1080` via SSH dynamic port forwarding.
    - Even after proxy recovery, Jess Flatmates inbox automation remained broken due to Flatmates anti-bot / protected login behaviour (`inputs=0`, login modal not rendered, likely 429/blocked path).
    - Key architectural lesson: old Jess browser design (`chromium.launch` headless + fresh context + auto-login + cookie/session hacks) is not reliable for Flatmates and should be treated as unsuitable for inbox automation.
